items.t: Seminole County clerk's office closed after cyber attack, services expected to resume Monday
items.x: The Seminole County Clerk of Courts Office remained closed for a second day Friday after it said a cyber attack forced it to shut down its computer systems.

items.t: Oviedo’s Bruder Brewery is a handsome pub with up-and-down grub
items.x: Bruder is an award-winning craft brewery with nearly a dozen locations in Colombia. This, its first stateside, exudes a thoughtfulness that suggests formula.

items.t: Orlando Maker Faire offers a full weekend of local innovation and creativity
items.x: Returning Nov. 7-8 to the Central Florida Fairgrounds for its 14th year, Maker Faire Orlando gathers artists, engineers, inventors and DIY enthusiasts to show off what they’ve been tinkering with.

items.t: Mamdani says Trump agrees to grant visa to mother of Ghanian teen killed in Bronx shooting
items.x: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani says President Donald Trump has agreed to grant a visa to the mother of a 15-year-old immigrant from Ghana who was shot to death earlier this week.

items.t: Rubio says the US government did not facilitate Bolsonaro’s flight to the US
items.x: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio says the Trump administration did not help Flávio Bolsonaro leave Brazil after his election defeat.

items.t: Gov. DeSantis suspends Kissimmee Mayor Jackie Espinosa
items.x: Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis suspended Kissimmee Mayor Jackie Espinosa on Friday via an executive order.

items.t: Sumter school employee accused of multiple burglary, sexual-battery incidents targeting retirement communities
items.x: A man booked early Saturday by Sumter County deputies is accused of multiple burglary and sexual-battery incidents targeting residents of retirement communities, according to the sheriff's office.

items.t: Heavy rains expected to bring flooding risk to already saturated parts of the US Southwest
items.x: The National Weather Service says heavy rains are expected to bring a threat of flash flooding to already saturated areas of the U.S. Southwest.

items.t: Federal officials investigate fire at beleaguered police department in Mississippi
items.x: A fire Saturday morning damaged the building of a beleaguered police department in Mississippi that has drawn outrage from the community in recent months after an officer shot and killed a 1-year-old.

items.t: Attorneys for Alaska say 'meritless' Trump demand to set aside Senate ballots 'not even possible'
items.x: Alaska’s Republican-run state government is urging a federal judge to dismiss a lawsuit filed at President Donald Trump’s direction to stop the certification of a possible Democratic win in that state’s pivotal U.S. Senate race.

items.t: 'Grasping at straws': Judge dismisses Trump suit against Wall Street Journal over Epstein letter
items.x: A federal judge has dismissed President Donald Trump’s multibillion-dollar lawsuit against The Wall Street Journal and media mogul Rupert Murdoch over a story reporting on his ties to wealthy financier Jeffrey Epstein.

items.t: 12-year-old girl found safe after being reported missing out of Orange County
items.x: Isabella Grace Bowman, 12, has been located in good health and is safe, according to the Orange County Sheriff's Office.
